visible.description: false hides every correction (a small 'corrections hidden' tag stays).

id.description: Names the correction in Marks. Defaults to its number.

kind.description: line, arrow and path use points; circle and rect use box; note is only a numbered note at 'at'.

points.description: [[x, y], …] in the overlay's own pixels (0, 0 is its top left). A path is smoothed through them.

box.description: [x, y, w, h] in the overlay's pixels.

at.description: Where the numbered note goes. Defaults to beside the shape.

text.description: The note, short: what to fix.

color.description: red (default), orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, violet, pink, or #rrggbb.
